title: Concept: Same-origin policy relaxed from script
description: A document.domain assignment in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Setting document.domain drops the origin to a registrable suffix, so every sibling subdomain becomes same-origin and one compromised host reads the bank's pages.
